messages:
Sam (devex): quick heads-up: after the 0.4.0 publish some onboarding samples (Next + Wrangler) fail in Cloudflare with `Error: No matching export` when importing `@redwood/inference-sdk/edge`. Repro attached below.

Leah (eng-runtime): ouch. paste the published package.json exports and the exact import path consumers use?

Sam (devex): consumers do `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference-sdk/edge'`. Published snippet: "exports": { "./node":"./dist/node.cjs.js", "./edge":"./dist/edge.mjs", "./*":"./dist/*.js" }. Editors also stop resolving `edge` typings.

Marcus (eng-ml): explicit subpath exports + missing TS mapping = runtime + editor break. Workers' loader is picky about conditional exports and will reject if the subpath isn't matched exactly.

Ava (devex): we probably removed a wildcard in the last refactor. Quick win: add a root proxy file `edge.mjs` that re-exports `./dist/edge.mjs` so older loaders and bundlers that ignore exports maps still find it. Also add types for the subpath.

Leah (eng-runtime): agree. Preferred fix: keep explicit `./edge` but make it a condition object: { "import": "./dist/edge.mjs", "default": "./dist/edge.cjs.js" } and add `typesVersions` or "./edge.d.ts" mapping so TS resolves `@redwood/inference-sdk/edge`. Also add an npm-pack resolution smoke test against Cloudflare/Bun/Node ESM in release CI.

Sam (devex): will open PR with: (1) root `edge.mjs` proxy, (2) exports condition-object for `./edge`, (3) `edge.d.ts` + typesVersions, (4) tiny pack+resolve CI test.

CI-bot: sample-apps/workers job failing on main  import-resolution-error  related to sdk@0.4.0 (job 5248).

Marcus (eng-ml): also add a short blurb in onboarding README about preferred import patterns (top-level vs subpath) and how typings are mapped so customers don't copy a path that won't be stable across packaging changes.

Ava (devex): once PR is green publish a 0.4.1-canary and run the onboarding matrix (Next/Vite/Bun/Wrangler). I'll prepare a changelog note and customer pings.

Sam (devex): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1301 with the proxy + exports + types + smoke test. Running CI.

Leah (eng-runtime): nice. follow-up: add an automated npm-pack/export-resolution check in the release checklist so this doesn't slip again. Assigning to eng-runtime.

Sam (devex): update: CI green, canary 0.4.1-canary.2 published, onboarding samples verified on Cloudflare. Monitoring errors for 48h. :thumbsup:

(reacts: :eyes: :shipit:)
